Who we are

Every journey is personal.
So is our care.

Founded in 2016, Bigfoot Medicare Pte Ltd provides medical and wheelchair transport for individuals, healthcare institutions and nursing homes across Singapore.

We bridge mobility gaps through safe, compassionate and professional support. Whether it’s a hospital visit, regular treatment or a journey home, patient comfort and dignity guide the way we work.

  • Patient-centred care
  • Trained transport crew
  • Singapore-wide service
  • Mobility & escort support
Meet your next step ↗
What we do

Different needs.
The same thoughtful care.

The right level of support for your journey, from accessible transport to medical supervision and care.

Care that travels with you

Our Medical Transport Service supports patients who need mobility assistance and basic medical attention during travel. Clinical crew and onboard equipment help support the journey. An EMT escort option is available for closer supervision.

  • Clinical crew
  • Onboard equipment
  • EMT escort option
Book an appointment ↗

A more comfortable way to go

Travel with accessible vehicles equipped with wheelchair lifts, L-track fittings and restraints. Our Wheelchair Transport Service helps wheelchair users get to healthcare appointments and home with comfort and support. Escort services are also available.

  • Wheelchair lift
  • Secure restraints
  • Escort option
Book an appointment ↗

Ready to support your event

Arrange a medical team and equipped transport vehicle for events, workplaces or environments that need medical standby. Discuss your event requirements and appropriate support with our team.

  • Medical crew
  • Equipped vehicle
  • Event support
Book an appointment ↗

Care aides & dialysis escorts

Assistance with daily activities, hospital visits and regular dialysis journeys.

Medical equipment & consumables

Equipment and essential supplies to support healthcare and patient care needs.

Training & certification

Courses in AED, CPR, First Aid, BCLS and EMT training, conducted by certified professionals.

A little clarity

Good questions.
Helpful answers.

Need something more specific? Our team is here to help.

Ask us on WhatsApp ↗
How do I book a journey?

Use “Book an appointment” to open our existing appointment form, or WhatsApp +65 9797 7323 to discuss your needs with our operator. Availability and arrangements are confirmed by the team.

What areas do you cover?

We serve locations across Singapore, providing patient transport between homes and healthcare institutions.

What are your operating hours?

Frontline services operate Monday to Sunday, 7 am to 7 pm. Office hours are Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm.

Can a wheelchair user travel with a companion?

Our wheelchair transport vehicles accommodate wheelchair users and seated passengers. Capacity depends on the vehicle and individual requirements; please confirm the arrangements when booking.

Is this an emergency ambulance service?

Our patient transport services focus on non-emergency journeys. For booking questions or medical standby arrangements, speak directly with the team.
